name: POS Lot & Serial Selection
description: This module extends Odoo Point of Sale (POS) by allowing cashiers to select Lot/Serial Numbers directly during the POS sales process. It also supports Expiration Date tracking for better inventory management
summary: The POS Lot/Serial Selection Module provides a seamless solution for managing serialized products within Odoo’s Point of Sale system. This module ensures that every item sold through POS can be tracked with precise lot or serial numbers, enabling businesses to maintain accurate inventory control, streamline operations, and enhance product traceability. In the backend, users can easily create and manage lot/serial numbers for products. For example, a product like Storage Box can have multiple serial numbers assigned (e.g., Ser/01, Ser/02, Ser/03, Ser/04). Each serial number is tied to its own available quantity, expiration date, and history, ensuring businesses can track stock at the most detailed level. The system also provides options for replenishment and history review, helping managers stay informed about stock levels and product movements. In the POS interface, when a cashier selects a serialized product, a popup appears prompting them to choose from available lot/serial numbers. The interface displays key details such as available quantity, expiration date, removal date, and use date for each serial number, allowing accurate selection during sales. This step eliminates errors and ensures the right serials are allocated to customers. Users can adjust the required quantity by increasing or decreasing the number of units selected for each serial, making the process flexible and straightforward.
